heroHeadline: Day 4,852: Mexico's President Says BTS Set to Return in 2027
heroSubtitle: September 25, 2026 is Day 4,852 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said Sept 24, alongside South Korean President Lee Jae-myung during his state visit to the National Palace, that she is looking forward to BTS's return to Mexico in 2027, following the group's May 2026 ARIRANG Tour stop in Mexico City — HYBE has not confirmed any visit. Over the same Chuseok holiday week (Sept 24-26), Jungkook departed Gimpo International Airport for an individual schedule in Tokyo on Sept 23, just two days after returning from the US, prompting unconfirmed fan speculation about a Calvin Klein appearance after a crowd gathered outside the brand's Harajuku store. BTS's ARIRANG album also extended its Billboard 200 run to 25 consecutive weeks (chart dated Sept 19). The tour's Latin American leg opens in Bogotá, Colombia on Oct 2-3 before continuing to Lima, Santiago, La Plata and São Paulo.
